name: skills
description: Personal Claude Code plugins for remote agent workflows, upstream contributions, and cross-model consensus.

plugins.name: dispatch
plugins.description: Delegate remote work and collect a verified result, or use --pass to hand over the full task and workspace after a signed receiver acknowledgment.

plugins.name: upstream
plugins.description: Run issue-linked upstream work in an isolated worktree, from specification and draft PR through small commits, independent reviews, and bot-feedback monitoring.

plugins.name: consensus
plugins.description: Ask multiple AI model CLIs one question in parallel, then synthesize a canonical answer with dissent surfaced.
